audit_items.proof_trace: The repay_amount function computes excess = coin.value() - ceil(debt) and adds it to cash_reserve; the exchange_rate numerator (cash + debt - cash_reserve) cancels the effect exactly — the P deposited into cash and P - ceil(D) added to cash_reserve net to only ceil(D) contributing to the rate. The at-most-1-unit rounding artifact from ceil(D) - D is standard integer rounding of fractional debt and does not constitute a meaningful benefit to depositors.
